items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The other bandstand was Mal Hallett, and then the one that I thought was the Empire Ballroom, the band on the other stand was Paul Whiteman.

ctx.x: No, it was a ballroom downtown on Broadway, and it had two bandstands. The other bandstand was Mal Hallett, and then the one that I thought was the Empire Ballroom, the band on the other stand was Paul Whiteman.

items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I do remember that there was Mal Hallett, and there was a saxophone player with him that I liked particularly

ctx.x: Who were some of the bands that played at the Arcadia? I guess there were mor than one -- at the time you were there.
I remember one, and there were certainly more -- but I do remember that there was Mal Hallett, and there was a saxophone player with him that I liked particularly -- and that was 'Toots' Mondello.
